ground_materials.name: gravel
ground_materials.where: along well-traveled paths, around farm and town buildings, and as patches on slopes (>15 degrees), blended via noise mask
ground_materials.why: adds realism around human areas and wears on trails, plus erosion on slopes
ground_materials.image_prompt: seamless top-down 16px texture, scattered round gray and brown stones over tan packed dirt, low contrast, faceted pixel look

ground_materials.name: cracked_clay
ground_materials.where: in dry valleys and flat low spots below elevation 0 (valley mask), with higher density near desert vegetation
ground_materials.why: highlights aridness of lowlands, visual break from simple grass, sells climate
ground_materials.image_prompt: seamless top-down 16px texture, irregular light tan clay cracks, wide dry gaps, faceted shading, some darker shadows in cracks

ground_materials.name: muddy_soil
ground_materials.where: along rivers or where trails cross valleys, especially in shade and around forest edge (valley AND forest zone flags)
ground_materials.why: shows vegetation-linked moisture and trail wear in forest/valley edges
ground_materials.image_prompt: seamless top-down 16px texture, mottled dark brown wet soil with darker puddles, soft pixel transitions, occasional gray leaf

ground_materials.name: rocky_outcrop
ground_materials.where: on exposed hilltops and ridges above elevation 8m (height AND slope >10°), using a spotty noise mask
ground_materials.why: creates topographical variety, aids navigation, realistic for arid hills
ground_materials.image_prompt: seamless top-down 16px texture, clusters of rough angular gray rocks, with orange lichen patches, surrounded by bare light dirt

grass_types.name: wildflower_patch
grass_types.color: mixed goldenrod yellow, faded orange, and pale pink petals with olive-green stalks
grass_types.where: random patches (low-frequency noise mask) in valleys and near wheat field edges
grass_types.why: adds color and variety, shows seasonal wild growth
grass_types.image_prompt: overhead cluster of low wildflowers, each with 3-4 bright pixel petals, tiny stems on olive ground, pixel-art style

grass_types.name: sage_clump
grass_types.color: muted gray-green leaves, hint of blue tint, pale tan woody stems
grass_types.where: on rocky or gravelly terrain (matches gravel/rocky_outcrop materials), blended via noise
grass_types.why: matches arid, exposed areas; regional realism
grass_types.image_prompt: small mound of sagebrush, oval pixel leaves, blue-gray clusters, rough tan sticks, viewed top-down low-res

grass_types.name: low_crawling_vines
grass_types.color: deep green leaves with dark red berry dots
grass_types.where: dense under forest trees and near muddy_soil, high moisture (forest AND valley zones, noise mask)
grass_types.why: fills forest floor, visual richness, different biome flavor
grass_types.image_prompt: interwoven pixel vines, dense dark green with scattered red berries, flat to ground, top-down pixel art
